title: tragoselinum luteum
intro: Tragoselinum luteum, commonly known as yellow wild ginger, is a perennial plant belonging to the Zingiberaceae family. It is native to Southeast Asia and has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antispasmodic properties, helping to alleviate digestive issues, reduce pain, and soothe respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents of Tragoselinum luteum include gingerols, shogaols, and zingiberene, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant effects. The plant's therapeutic actions make it a valuable remedy for various health conditions, offering relief from nausea, fever, and muscle spasms, as well as supporting immune function and overall well-being.
